## Authority and safety
- [ ] No new silent fallback from PENDING/unsupported to success
- [ ] Observer/UI/debug state remains non-authoritative
- [ ] Resource/ownership/material changes have an explicit commit path
- [ ] Security/privacy implications reviewed

## Provenance
- [ ] Third-party code/assets/data identified and license-compatible
- [ ] Required notices/attribution preserved
- [ ] Comparative references are not presented as incorporated code
- [ ] Substantive AI assistance disclosed where relevant
- [ ] No secrets/private telemetry included

## Repository hygiene
- [ ] Generated build artifacts excluded unless intentionally archived as evidence
- [ ] Documentation/state index updated if authority changed
- [ ] Failures/errata preserved instead of rewritten away
- [ ] License status accurately represented
